_how_to_use: A monster sheet: fill it in, then import it into the encounter builder with
import-monsters "path/to/this file.json"   (or drag the file onto the import-monsters script)
1. Copy this file somewhere (e.g. next to the book it's from) and rename it.
2. Set source (a short name, lowercase, no spaces - it names the file it becomes) and title (shown in the builder's Source filter).
3. Replace the two example creatures with yours. Copy the Bog Hag Matron block for each full stat block; the Grave Knight shows the least you need.
4. Run the import. Anything wrong is listed by the creature's name and that creature is left out; fix the sheet and run it again.
Importing again replaces everything from this sheet, so the sheet is the thing to keep and edit.
Anything starting with _ (like this note and _fields below) is ignored, so you can leave it in or delete it.
JSON rules: text in "double quotes", a comma between entries but not after the last one, true/false and numbers without quotes.

_fields.name: Required.
_fields.cr: Required. 0, "1/8", "1/4", "1/2", 1 ... 30 (fractions in quotes). XP is worked out from it.
_fields.id: Optional; made from source + name (e.g. homebrew-bog-hag-matron).
_fields.type: The italic line under the name, e.g. "Medium fey, neutral evil". Or leave it out and give size, creature_type, and alignment.
_fields.size / creature_type: For the builder's filters; read from type if left out. size: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gargantuan.
_fields.environments: A list: Arctic, Coastal, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hills, Jungle, Mountains, Swamp, Underdark, Underwater, Urban...
_fields.ac: 15, or "15 (natural armor)". ac_note is the part in brackets.
_fields.hp: Leave it out to use the average of hp_formula ("13d8 + 52").
_fields.abilities: All six: {"str": 18, ...} or a list [18, 12, 18, 14, 14, 16] in STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA order.
_fields.traits / actions / bonus_actions / react: Lists of {"name": ..., "text": ...}. "Melee Weapon Attack:" and "Hit:" are put in italics for you; *italic* and **bold** work.
_fields.page: The book page; shown at the bottom of the stat block.
_fields.note: Anything else for the bottom of the stat block.
